title: PDF to Excel - Tables, XLSX Downloads & PDF转Excel
description: Minimal input: {"documentUrls": ["https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsvine/pdfplumber/stable/examples/pdfs/background-checks.pdf"], "startPage": 1, "maxPagesPerDocument": 5, "tableStrategy": "lines"}. One paid row per PDF page with tables.

documentUrls.title: documentUrls
documentUrls.description: Public PDF URLs, e.g. the prefilled pdfplumber sample. Up to 100; 12 MB each. One billed row per qualifying page; digital text only, no scanned-page OCR.

startPage.title: startPage
startPage.description: First PDF page to inspect, one-based, e.g. 2. Default 1. Pages before this are not inspected or billed.

maxPagesPerDocument.title: maxPagesPerDocument
maxPagesPerDocument.description: Maximum PDF pages inspected per document, 1–20. Default 5. Blank pages or pages with no tables still consume this scan limit but are free.

tableStrategy.title: tableStrategy
tableStrategy.description: "lines" (default) detects ruled tables; "text" uses text alignment for borderless tables. Review a sample. No OCR; one billed page includes every detected table.

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the run, 1–1000, default 20. Example: 3 for a sample. Exclusions and empty results apply before the cap.

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Prior output id values to skip before billing, up to 5,000. Empty [] disables. Suppresses that identity even if content changed.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: Prior output content_hash values (64 lowercase hex characters), up to 5,000. Empty [] disables. Matching snapshots are skipped before billing.
